title: ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance
title_zh: ODDR：基于奖励引导的一步去影扩散

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to narrow the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model. Our project page is available here .

paragraphs.en: Shadows introduce strong illumination mismatches and visible boundary transitions that harm perceptual quality [ 67 ] and hinder downstream vision tasks, such as text recognition [ 32 ] and semantic segmentation [ 23 ] . The goal of shadow removal is to eliminate these artifacts and restore images that are both natural in appearance and suitable for subsequent applications like robotics [ 47 , 1 ] .

paragraphs.en: Recent learning-based approaches substantially improve shadow removal quality through CNN and Transformer-based architectures [ 7 , 6 , 11 , 60 ] . However, many of these approaches require strict supervision using paired real-world data, necessitating precise alignment between shadow images and their shadow-free ground truths. Unfortunately, collecting such real-world pairs is labor-intensive and often unreliable: scene changes, exposure variation, and illumination fluctuations make alignment difficult, and the resulting datasets are typically limited in diversity. This limitation leads to a noticeable performance gap between controlled benchmarks and real-world scenarios, where shadows exhibit complex geometry and color interactions. While previous works have proposed alternatives to bypass the need for real-world paired datasets, these approaches often come with their own inherent drawbacks. GAN-based [ 18 , 36 , 25 ] approaches rely on adversarial objectives to translate shadowed images into shadow-free ones, but often suffer from unstable training and inconsistent restoration quality. Synthetic dataset generation [ 19 ] provides paired supervision by rendering shadows onto clean images, yet models trained on synthetic pairs often struggle to remove real-world shadows due to domain gaps. Recent diffusion-based approaches [ 13 ] address perceptual quality using generative priors, but their iterative sampling procedures lead to high inference latency, which limits practical usage in time-sensitive applications. Therefore, we aim to elevate perceptual fidelity and inference efficiency without relying on real-world paired datasets, achieving this by preserving the strong perceptual priors of diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基于学习的方法通过 CNN 和 Transformer 架构显著提升了阴影去除质量 [ 7 , 6 , 11 , 60 ] 。 然而，这些方法中的许多都需要使用配对的真实世界数据进行严格监督，这要求阴影图像与其无阴影的参考图像之间实现精确对齐。 遗憾的是，收集这类真实世界的配对数据既费力又常常不可靠：场景变化、曝光差异和光照波动使得对齐变得困难，而由此产生的数据集通常多样性有限。 这一局限性导致了受控基准测试与真实世界场景之间明显的性能差距，因为在真实世界中，阴影呈现出复杂的几何结构和色彩交互。 尽管先前的研究提出了替代方案以绕过对真实世界配对数据集的需求，但这些方法往往也伴随着其固有的缺点。 基于 GAN 的方法 [ 18 , 36 , 25 ] 依赖对抗性目标将带阴影的图像转换为无阴影图像，但常常面临训练不稳定和恢复质量不一致的问题。 合成数据集生成方法 [ 19 ] 通过渲染阴影到干净图像上提供配对监督，但使用合成数据对训练的模型由于域差异往往难以去除真实世界的阴影。 近期的基于扩散模型的方法 [ 13 ] 利用生成性先验解决了感知质量的问题，但其迭代采样过程导致了较高的推理延迟，从而限制了其在时间敏感应用中的实际使用。 因此，我们的目标是在不依赖真实世界配对数据集的前提下提升感知保真度和推理效率，这可以通过保留扩散模型强大的感知先验来实现。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we observe that although diffusion priors offer a robust initialization, achieving real-world generalization necessitates training on real shadow artifacts that synthetic datasets fail to capture. To address this, we introduce a two-stage framework that integrates a diffusion-prior backbone with a novel, shadow-specific perceptual reward model.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们观察到，尽管扩散先验能够提供稳健的初始化，但要实现真实世界的泛化能力，必须在合成数据集无法捕捉到的真实阴影伪影上进行训练。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种两阶段框架，该框架将基于扩散先验的主干网络与一种全新的、针对阴影设计的感知奖励模型相结合。

paragraphs.en: In the first stage, we propose a baseline model, O ne-step D eshadow D iffusion ( ODD ), by adapting a pretrained text-to-image latent diffusion model to perform shadow removal in a single denoising step using only synthetic shadow and shadow-free pairs. This diffusion-prior-based training improves structural and color consistency while avoiding common instabilities of GAN-based training. In addition, compared to multi-step diffusion [ 12 , 13 ] , this one-step generation drastically reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段，我们通过将预训练的文本到图像潜在扩散模型进行适配，提出了一种基线模型——单步去影扩散（ODD），该模型仅使用合成阴影与无阴影图像对，在单次去噪步骤中完成阴影移除。 这种基于扩散先验的训练方法提升了结构一致性和色彩一致性，同时避免了基于GAN训练常见的不稳定性问题。 此外，与多步扩散 [12, 13] 相比，这种单步生成方法在推理阶段大幅减少了函数求值次数（NFE）。

paragraphs.en: In the second stage, we refine ODD into O ne-step D eshadow D iffusion via R eward guidance ( ODDR ). Notably, we employ reward-guided optimization directly on images containing real shadows, without requiring corresponding shadow-free references. Specifically, we introduce ShadowReward , a reward model tailored to shadow removal that approximates human perceptual judgments without relying on manual annotation. ShadowReward is trained by ranking synthetically corrupted images with controlled degradations that mimic common shadow removal failures, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. During ODDR fine-tuning, the frozen ODD prediction acts as a pseudo target to preserve structural fidelity, while the reward term encourages outputs that receive higher scores from ShadowReward. By enabling real-world refinement without real-world paired datasets, this strategy narrows the synthetic-to-real domain gap and enhances perceptual quality without compromising the baseline content or color tone.

paragraphs.en: Shadow removal methods learn to reconstruct shadow-free images from shadowed inputs by modeling illumination and appearance changes caused by shadows. Recent approaches utilizing CNNs enhance exposure balance and boundary smoothness via multi-exposure fusion [ 8 ] , aggregation based on matting [ 7 ] , style harmonization [ 51 ] , and invertible mappings [ 68 ] . Transformer models are particularly effective in capturing global context and long-range dependencies, which facilitates consistent illumination restoration [ 11 , 60 , 61 ] . Additionally, diffusion-based approaches contribute to stabilizing texture recovery and preserving details by employing adaptive attention and latent diffusion with detail injection, resulting in more realistic appearances [ 12 , 62 ] . However, diffusion variants, despite their perceptual improvements, come with significant inference costs. Moreover, these models are still prone to exposure bias in the training data [ 52 , 44 ] .

paragraphs.en: To overcome the reliance on paired datasets, various methods have been extensively explored for shadow removal. GAN-based approaches employ adversarial or cycle objectives, often with mask guidance, domain-classifier cues, lightness guidance, or non-cyclic unidirectional design [ 18 , 21 , 35 , 28 , 36 , 25 ] , enhancing color fidelity and penumbra smoothness without aligned pairs. BCDiff [ 13 ] , a diffusion-based method, removes shadows by separating boundary and inner-shadow regions, using non-shadow context for boundary areas and intrinsic decomposition for inner-shadow recovery. SynShadow [ 19 ] introduces a physics-based synthetic shadow generation method that produces diverse shadow shapes and intensities without paired labels, improving the robustness of deshadowing networks. However, while such methods eliminate the need for paired data, they typically underperform in shadow removal compared to paired approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 为了克服对配对数据集的依赖，研究人员广泛探索了多种阴影去除方法。 基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的方法采用对抗性或循环目标函数，通常结合掩码引导、领域分类器提示、亮度引导或非循环单向设计 [ 18 , 21 , 35 , 28 , 36 , 25 ] ，从而在没有配对数据的情况下提升色彩保真度和半影区域的平滑度。 BCDiff [ 13 ] 是一种基于扩散模型的方法，通过分离边界区域和内部阴影区域来去除阴影：对边界区域使用非阴影上下文信息，对内部阴影区域则采用内在分解进行恢复。 SynShadow [ 19 ] 提出了一种基于物理的阴影合成生成方法，无需配对标签即可生成形状和强度各异的阴影，从而提升了去影网络的鲁棒性。 然而，尽管这些方法消除了对配对数据的需求，但在阴影去除效果上通常不如基于配对数据的方法。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models [ 16 , 46 ] generate high-quality images through iterative denoising steps that gradually refine random noise into realistic samples. While this iterative process enables strong generative capability, it also results in high inference latency and computational overhead in shadow removal [ 12 , 62 ] . To address these issues, recent studies have explored one-step diffusion models [ 65 , 55 ] that distill the entire multi-step denoising trajectory into a single forward pass. This architecture enables efficient task adaptation through lightweight fine-tuning mechanisms, such as LoRA [ 17 ] . These one-step models have demonstrated impressive efficiency and performance across various image restoration tasks such as super-resolution [ 49 ] , JPEG artifact removal [ 10 ] , and deblurring [ 34 ] . Inspired by these successes and by recent findings that pretrained diffusion models can be efficiently fine-tuned for single-step prediction [ 39 ] , we adapt the one-step diffusion paradigm to shadow removal. Rather than the one-step formulation itself, our contribution lies in the architectural designs that make it effective for shadow removal and in the annotation-free reward guidance described below.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型 [ 16 , 46 ] 通过迭代去噪步骤生成高质量图像，这些步骤逐步将随机噪声精炼为逼真的样本。 尽管这种迭代过程实现了强大的生成能力，但也导致在阴影去除 [ 12 , 62 ] 中产生较高的推理延迟和计算开销。 为解决这些问题，近期研究探索了单步扩散模型 [ 65 , 55 ]，它将整个多步去噪轨迹浓缩为单次前向传播。 这种架构通过轻量级微调机制（如 LoRA [ 17 ]）实现了高效的任务适配。 这些单步模型在各种图像恢复任务中展现了出色的效率和性能，例如超分辨率 [ 49 ]、JPEG 伪影去除 [ 10 ] 和去模糊 [ 34 ]。 受这些成功以及近期发现的启发——预训练的扩散模型可以高效微调以实现单步预测 [ 39 ]，我们将单步扩散范式应用于阴影去除。 我们的贡献并非单步公式本身，而是使其在阴影去除中有效的架构设计，以及下文描述的无需标注的奖励引导方法。

paragraphs.en: Reward modeling has become a central component in reinforcement learning with human feedback, where a learned reward function is optimized to align model outputs with human preferences [ 70 , 3 ] . Such approaches have recently gained substantial attention in large language models [ 41 , 58 ] . Beyond language modeling, preference-based learning has also been extended to various computer vision tasks, including face restoration [ 54 ] , image generation [ 63 , 31 , 24 , 57 ] , video generation [ 29 ] , and 3D generation [ 64 ] . These methods demonstrate that reward supervision can effectively improve perceptual quality by aligning model outputs with human judgments. However, existing reward models typically rely on preference datasets constructed from large-scale human annotations, which are costly and labor-intensive to collect. This dependency limits their scalability and practical applicability, particularly in low-level vision tasks where fine-grained perceptual differences are critical. To alleviate this limitation, recent image restoration studies have explored automated preference supervision using vision-language models (VLMs) [ 2 ] or perceptual Image Quality Assessment (IQA) metrics in super-resolution tasks [ 56 , 43 ] . Nevertheless, such strategies have not yet been specifically tailored to the shadow removal problem. In this work, we introduce the first reward model designed for shadow removal. Notably, our proposed model is trained entirely without human annotations, yet provides human-aligned perceptual guidance to improve restoration quality.

paragraphs.en: Our proposed framework consists of two primary components: (i) One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a cost-effective one-step latent diffusion for deshadowing, and (ii) One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), an enhanced version of ODD for real-world scenarios guided by a preference-based reward model (ShadowReward). As shown in Fig. 2 , we first train ODD by adapting Stable Diffusion (SD) [ 46 ] using synthetic shadow and shadow-free pairs [ 19 ] . Subsequently, we refine ODD through ShadowReward, which provides perceptual feedback to assist in the fine-tuning process. This results in our final model, ODDR, which significantly enhances shadow removal performance in real scenarios. In the following, Sec. 3.2 describes the ODD baseline model, Sec. 3.3 introduces the reward-guided refinement for ODDR including the ShadowReward model and its human-annotation-free training procedure.

paragraphs.en: In general, deshadow models trained without real-world paired datasets struggle to match the performance of fully supervised approaches in real scenarios. To bridge this gap, we harness the image priors of Stable Diffusion (SD) [ 46 ] to construct our baseline model, ODD, which significantly enhances deshadowing quality without using the real-world paired dataset. However, SD relies on iterative denoising that requires many inference steps, leading to high computational cost and latency. Furthermore, because intermediate diffusion states remain distant from the final image, providing direct pixel-level feedback from the reward model is very challenging. To overcome these limitations, we adopt the one-step formulation from OSEDiff [ 55 ] , which replaces stochastic multi-step denoising with a single deterministic mapping that directly predicts a shadow-free image.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，在没有真实世界配对数据集的情况下训练的去阴影模型，在真实场景中难以与完全监督的方法相媲美。 为了弥合这一差距，我们利用 Stable Diffusion（SD）[46] 的图像先验知识来构建我们的基线模型 ODD，该模型无需使用真实世界的配对数据集即可显著提升去阴影质量。 然而，SD 依赖迭代降噪过程，需要大量推理步骤，从而导致高计算成本和延迟。 此外，由于中间扩散状态与最终图像仍存在较大差异，因此从奖励模型中提供直接的像素级反馈极具挑战性。 为克服这些局限性，我们采用了 OSEDiff [55] 中的一步公式，该公式用单一的确定性映射取代了随机多步降噪，直接预测出无阴影的图像。

paragraphs.en: Although ODD achieves effective reconstruction as a baseline, it still presents two significant drawbacks. First, because it is trained exclusively on synthetically shadowed images, a noticeable domain gap remains when applied to real-world shadows with complex lighting and color. Second, while LPIPS enforces feature-level alignment with the ground truth, it frequently overlooks visually salient artifacts inherent to shadow removal, including texture degradation, noise, color deviations, luminance fluctuations, and boundary seams. To overcome these limitations, we present ODDR, which adapts the baseline model (ODD) with a perceptual reward model (ShadowReward) to better align with human visual judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ODD 作为基线模型实现了有效的重建，但它仍然存在两个显著的缺点。 首先，由于它仅在合成阴影图像上进行训练，因此当应用于具有复杂光照和颜色的真实世界阴影时，仍存在明显的领域差异。 其次，虽然 LPIPS 强制特征层与真实值对齐，但它常常忽略掉阴影去除过程中在视觉上显著的人工伪影，包括纹理退化、噪声、颜色偏差、亮度波动和边界接缝。 为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 ODDR，它通过引入感知奖励模型（ShadowReward）对基线模型（ODD）进行改进，以更好地与人类视觉判断保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Ranking Deshadow Preference (ShadowReward) In this work, we employ a reward model to fine-tune the baseline ODD model, which significantly enhances the perceptual quality of the final output. In the context of the reward model, human visual preference serves as a natural standard for assessing the quality of shadow removal results, and observers primarily evaluate the quality of restoration through boundary smoothness, color consistency, and texture realism [ 50 ] . However, collecting the human-annotated preference data required to train such reward models is a time-consuming and expensive process. To address this problem, we present ShadowReward , a reward model designed to mimic human preference without the need for human annotation to assess the quality of shadow removal.
paragraphs.zh: 排名去影偏好（ShadowReward）：在本研究中，我们采用一种奖励模型对基线 ODD 模型进行微调，从而显著提升最终输出的感知质量。 在奖励模型的框架下，人类的视觉偏好是评估去影结果质量的自然标准，观察者主要通过边界平滑度、颜色一致性和纹理真实感来评价修复效果 [50]。 然而，收集训练此类奖励模型所需的人类标注偏好数据是一个耗时且成本高昂的过程。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ShadowReward——一种无需人类标注即可模拟人类偏好、用于评估去影质量的奖励模型。

paragraphs.en: Previous studies have shown that the level of image degradation influences perceptual preference, with more severely degraded images consistently judged as less favorable [ 42 , 26 ] . Motivated by this observation, we design a training strategy that leverages controlled degradations to induce preference ordering, enabling the reward model to learn human-like judgments without explicit annotation. Specifically, to simulate scenarios where conventional shadow removal models generally do not perform well, we corrupt images with specific degrees of texture distortion, noise, chromatic shift, luminance change, and boundary artifacts. Subsequently, we train ShadowReward to rank these corrupted images according to their degree of perceptual degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，图像退化程度会影响感知偏好，其中退化更严重的图像始终被认为不太理想 [ 42 , 26 ] 。 基于这一观察，我们设计了一种训练策略，利用可控的图像退化来引导偏好排序，使奖励模型无需显式标注即可学会类似人类的判断。 具体来说，为了模拟传统阴影移除模型通常表现不佳的场景，我们通过特定程度的纹理失真、噪声、色移、亮度变化和边界伪影来破坏图像。 随后，我们训练 ShadowReward 根据这些受损图像的感知退化程度对其进行排序。

sents.en: These include texture distortion, additive noise, chromatic shift, luminance change, and boundary artifacts.
sents.zh: 这些退化类型包括纹理失真、加法噪声、色移、亮度变化以及边界伪影。

sents.en: Each is applied with a range of degradation levels to control degradation strength.
sents.zh: 每种退化类型都会应用一系列不同的退化级别，以控制退化的强度。

sents.en: This process allows us to construct diverse and perceptually ordered training samples without any human annotation.
sents.zh: 这一过程使我们无需任何人工标注，就能构建出多样化且具有感知顺序的训练样本。

sents.en: Detailed settings are provided in our Appendix (Sec. A ).
sents.zh: 详细设置请参见我们的附录（第 A 节）。

paragraphs.en: Datasets We use the Adjusted ISTD (AISTD) dataset [ 52 , 27 ] for training, which contains 1,870 triplets of shadow, shadow mask, and shadow-free images with a resolution of 480 × 640 480\times 640 , where 1,330 triplets are used for training and 540 for testing. We utilize different components of the AISTD training set for each stage of our framework. ODD is trained solely on shadow-free images using synthetic shadow images generated from clean images in this dataset. For ODDR, we use only shadowed images from the training set. ShadowReward is trained on our Human-Annotation-Free dataset, which is constructed by augmenting AISTD shadow-free images with random shadow masks with SynShadow [ 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 数据集：我们使用调整后的 ISTD（AISTD）数据集 [52, 27] 进行训练，该数据集包含 1,870 个由阴影图像、阴影掩码和无阴影图像组成的三元组，分辨率为 480 × 640，其中 1,330 个三元组用于训练，540 个用于测试。 我们在框架的每个阶段都利用 AISTD 训练集的不同组成部分。 ODD 仅使用无阴影图像进行训练，这些图像通过该数据集中干净图像生成的合成阴影图像获得。 对于 ODDR，我们仅使用训练集中的带阴影图像。 ShadowReward 是在我们的无人工标注数据集上进行训练的，该数据集通过将 AISTD 中的无阴影图像与使用 SynShadow [19] 生成的随机阴影掩码进行增强而构建。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the generalization ability of our model, we conduct tests on three unseen real-world datasets, SRD [ 44 ] , LRSS [ 9 ] , and UIUC [ 14 ] . The SRD and LRSS datasets contain 408 and 34 test pairs, respectively. For the UIUC dataset, we use 44 test pairs with consistent light conditions from the original 76 pairs. These datasets provide diverse illumination and shadow configurations that differ from AISTD, enabling a fair and rigorous evaluation of cross-dataset generalization.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics Following previous works [ 27 , 8 ] , we use three standard metrics: Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structural Similarity (SSIM) [ 53 ] . RMSE is computed in the LAB color space to measure color consistency, while PSNR and SSIM are calculated in the RGB color space. Lower RMSE indicates smaller reconstruction errors, while higher PSNR and SSIM denote better restoration quality. All metrics are computed on images of size 256 × 256 256\times 256 using the MATLAB evaluation scripts from previous work [ 69 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标：遵循先前的研究 [ 27 , 8 ]，我们使用三种标准指标：均方根误差（RMSE）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似性（SSIM）[ 53 ]。 RMSE 在 LAB 颜色空间中计算以衡量颜色一致性，而 PSNR 和 SSIM 则在 RGB 颜色空间中计算。 RMSE 值越低表示重建误差越小，而 PSNR 和 SSIM 值越高则表示恢复质量越好。 所有指标均基于大小为 256 × 256 的图像，并使用先前研究 [ 69 ] 中的 MATLAB 评估脚本来计算。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details For ODD, we adopt the pretrained SD v2.1 model [ 46 ] as our backbone. The model is trained on 512 × 512 512\times 512 inputs, where smaller images are padded to this size using reflect padding. For optimization, we use the AdamW optimizer [ 38 ] with a batch size of 4 for 40K iterations, and a learning rate decaying from 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} to 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} via a cosine annealing scheduler [ 37 ] . For ShadowReward, we use 448 × 448 448\times 448 inputs, a batch size of 16, and the AdamW optimizer for 20K iterations with the same learning rate decay strategy as ODD. For ODDR, we use an identical setup to ODD, except that it is trained for 20K iterations with a fixed learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} . All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节：对于 ODD，我们采用预训练的 SD v2.1 模型 [46] 作为主干模型。 该模型在 512 × 512 的输入上进行训练，较小的图像通过反射填充方式扩展至该尺寸。 在优化方面，我们使用 AdamW 优化器 [38]，批量大小为 4，迭代次数为 40K，并通过余弦退火调度器 [37] 将学习率从 1 × 10⁻⁴ 衰减至 1 × 10⁻⁶。 对于 ShadowReward，我们使用 448 × 448 的输入，批量大小为 16，并使用 AdamW 优化器进行 20K 次迭代，学习率衰减策略与 ODD 相同。 对于 ODDR，我们采用与 ODD 完全相同的设置，不同之处在于其训练迭代次数为 20K，且使用固定的学习率 1 × 10⁻⁶。 所有实验均在单块 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU 上进行。

paragraphs.en: We compare the proposed method with various shadow removal approaches across different training data settings. For methods trained with real-world pairs, we evaluate against DHAN [ 7 ] , SP+M-Net [ 27 ] , Fu et al. [ 8 ] , BMNet [ 68 ] , SG-ShadowNet [ 51 ] , and OmniSR [ 61 ] . paragraphs.en: Impact of ShadowReward Model To validate the effectiveness of our ShadowReward model, we conduct two complementary evaluations summarized in Tab. 4 . paragraphs.en: Human Preference Alignment To quantitatively assess how accurately ShadowReward reflects human perceptual preferences for shadow removal, we perform an extensive user study involving 23 participants. Specifically, these individuals provided preference rankings for images generated by several shadow removal methods [ 35 , 62 , 36 , 25 ] , including our ODD and ODDR models, using the AISTD dataset. Subsequently, we rank the outcomes based on the predicted scores from each reward model and evaluate how closely these rankings align with human preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 人类偏好对齐：为了定量评估 ShadowReward 在反映人类对阴影移除的感知偏好方面的准确性，我们开展了一项涉及 23 名参与者的广泛用户研究。 具体来说，这些参与者使用 AISTD 数据集，对多种阴影移除方法 [35, 62, 36, 25] 生成的图像进行了偏好排序，其中包括我们的 ODD 和 ODDR 模型。 随后，我们根据每个奖励模型预测的分数对结果进行排序，并评估这些排序与人类偏好的吻合程度。

paragraphs.en: In Tab. 4 , the results for accuracy (ACC) confirm that ShadowReward aligns closely with human perceptual preferences. In contrast, existing reward models and rankings based on a non-reference image quality assessment metric (NR-IQA) exhibit low alignment accuracies (below 30%), as they rely on generic aesthetic or distortion cues rather than shadow-specific perceptual signals. Notably, a PSNR-based ranking yields an accuracy of 56.25% but necessitates ground-truth references for computation. ShadowReward outperforms this baseline with 68.75% alignment, demonstrating that our method provides a more reliable metric than pixel-level comparisons. More details on human evaluation are provided in the Appendix Sec. C .

paragraphs.en: Effect of Degradations for Human-Annotation-Free Dataset Beyond comparing ShadowReward against alternative reward models, we further analyze how the diversity of synthetic corruptions used to train ShadowReward affects its effectiveness. paragraphs.en: Conditioning Strategy We next examine the architectural choices made in the ODD baseline. We use BLIP [ 30 ] to extract text from the shadow image, input it to ODD with the text-conditioning module, and measure performance. We compare these results with our ODD, replacing the text-conditioning with self-attention. Conditioning on text generated by BLIP results in a slight enhancement compared to using a null prompt, whereas the suggested self-conditioning method (last row) delivers better performance across both Shadow and ALL regions.

paragraphs.en: We introduced One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), an efficient framework for high-quality shadow removal that requires no real-world paired supervision. Our approach builds upon One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline that performs single-step shadow-free reconstruction using only synthetic training data, and further refines it through a perceptual reward signal aligned with human preference. At the core of this process lies ShadowReward, a reward model trained on synthetically degraded images that mimic typical failure cases in shadow removal, guiding ODDR toward perceptually pleasing outputs without requiring ground-truth annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods without real-world paired supervision, shows strong generalization across diverse datasets, and remains highly efficient compared to multi-step diffusion-based models. A discussion of limitations, representative failure cases, and broader impacts is provided in our Appendix Sec. G .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了通过奖励引导的单步去影扩散（ODDR），这是一种高效的高品质去影框架，无需真实世界的成对监督数据。 我们的方法基于单步去影扩散（ODD）这一基线模型——该模型仅使用合成训练数据即可实现单步无阴影重建，并通过与人类偏好对齐的感知奖励信号进一步对其进行优化。 这一过程的核心是 ShadowReward，一个在模拟典型去影失败案例的合成退化图像上训练的奖励模型，它引导 ODDR 生成在感知上更令人满意的输出，而无需真实标签标注。 大量实验表明，在没有真实世界成对监督数据的方法中，我们的方法达到了当前最优性能，并在多样化数据集上展现出强大的泛化能力，同时与多步扩散模型相比仍保持高效。 关于局限性、典型的失败案例以及更广泛影响的讨论，请参见我们附录的 G 节。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments, we synthesize each training sample by applying multiple degradation types rather than relying on a single one. paragraphs.en: For ODD training (Eq. ( 1 )), we use the LPIPS perceptual loss [ 66 ] with a weighting factor of λ per = 2 \lambda_{\text{per}}=2 . When training ODDR (Eq. ( 2 )), we additionally apply the alignment loss with λ align = 2 \lambda_{\text{align}}=2 , and set the reward-guidance weight to λ r = 1 × 10 − 1 \lambda_{r}=1\times 10^{-1} . paragraphs.zh: 对于 ODD 训练（公式 (1)），我们使用 LPIPS 感知损失 [66]，其权重因子为 λ_per = 2\lambda_{\text{per}}=2。在训练 ODDR 时（公式 (2)），我们还额外应用了对齐损失，其中 λ_align = 2\lambda_{\text{align}}=2，并将奖励引导权重设为 λ_r = 1\times 10^{-1}\lambda_{r}=1\times 10^{-1}。对于 ShadowReward，我们使用温度参数 τ = 1\tau=1 来训练基于 ListMLE 的排序模型 [59]（公式 (5)）。所有超参数均通过经验选择，并在所有实验中保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: We use LoRA [ 17 ] with rank 16 and Gaussian initialization to adapt the frozen Stable Diffusion UNet. paragraphs.en: During training, we apply the following augmentations to the input images: (1) reflection padding to ensure a minimum resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 ; (2) random cropping to 512 × 512 512\times 512 ; (3) random horizontal flipping with probability 0.5; and (4) random rotation sampled from { 90 ∘ , 180 ∘ , 270 ∘ } \{90^{\circ},180^{\circ},270^{\circ}\} . paragraphs.en: To measure how well ShadowReward aligns with human preference, we conducted a user study collecting human rankings for shadow removal results. The survey interface, shown in Fig. 7 , was designed to facilitate direct visual comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量 ShadowReward 与人类偏好的契合度，我们开展了一项用户研究，收集了用户对阴影去除结果的排序。 如图 7 所示的调查问卷界面旨在促进直接的视觉比较。

paragraphs.en: Survey Structure / Interface : As illustrated in Fig. 7 , each question presented a 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid layout containing one input shadow image and three differently deshadowed results (labeled A, B, and C), where the three results were randomly selected from different shadow removal methods.
paragraphs.zh: 调查结构/界面：如图 7 所示，每个问题都采用 2×2 网格布局，其中包含一张输入阴影图像和三个经过不同去影处理的结果（分别标记为 A、B 和 C），这三个结果是从不同的去影方法中随机选择的。

paragraphs.en: Ranking Task : Participants were instructed to “rank images A, B, and C from the most effective shadow removal to the least effective.” We utilized a matrix-style selection interface, ensuring that annotators explicitly assigned a unique rank (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) to each candidate without duplication.
paragraphs.zh: 排序任务：参与者被要求“将图像 A、B 和 C 按照阴影去除效果从最有效到最不有效的顺序进行排序。”我们采用了一种矩阵式选择界面，确保标注者为每个候选图像明确分配一个唯一的排名（第 1、第 2 或第 3 名），且排名不得重复。

paragraphs.en: Data Source : The 16 input images were randomly selected from the AISTD test dataset [ 27 ] . The three comparison images for each question were sampled from a pool of six different models: four existing deshadowing models [ 35 , 62 , 36 , 25 ] and our proposed ODD and ODDR models. The positions of the candidate images (A, B, C) were randomized for each question to prevent positional bias.
paragraphs.zh: 数据源：16 张输入图像是从 AISTD 测试数据集 [27] 中随机选择的。 每个问题的三张对比图像均从六个不同模型的集合中采样：四个现有的去阴影模型 [35, 62, 36, 25]，以及我们提出的 ODD 和 ODDR 模型。 为每个问题随机打乱候选图像（A、B、C）的位置，以避免位置偏差。

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate that ShadowReward better captures human preference for shadow removal quality, we compare it against existing reward models commonly used in image generation: ImageReward [ 63 ] and PickScore [ 24 ] . As shown in Fig. 8 , general-purpose reward models do not align with human rankings for shadow removal results. They often favor images with stronger global semantics, disregarding noticeable residual shadows or color distortions. In contrast, ShadowReward consistently aligns with human-preferred ordering, accurately prioritizing restorations that feature clean shadow removal and coherent illumination. This demonstrates that ShadowReward is specifically well-aligned with the requirements of shadow removal, providing task-aware perceptual judgments that general-purpose VLM-based reward models cannot achieve.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明 ShadowReward 能更好地捕捉人类对阴影去除质量的偏好，我们将其与图像生成中常用的现有奖励模型进行了比较：ImageReward [63] 和 PickScore [24]。 如图 8 所示，通用型奖励模型无法与人类对阴影去除结果的排序保持一致。 这些模型往往更青睐具有更强全局语义的图像，而忽视了明显的残留阴影或色彩失真。 相比之下，ShadowReward 始终与人类偏好的排序一致，能够准确优先选择那些阴影去除干净且光照连贯的修复结果。 这表明 ShadowReward 专门针对阴影去除的需求进行了优化，能够提供通用型基于 VLM 的奖励模型无法实现的任务感知性感知判断。

paragraphs.en: Traditional metrics such as PSNR depend on strict pixel-level correspondence with paired ground truth and therefore become unreliable when misalignment occurs between two images. As illustrated in Fig. 9 , mismatches stemming from transient objects (e.g., the shoe in the top row) or environmental movements (e.g., shifting grass in the bottom row) lead to unfairly low PSNR scores for high-quality restorations, even when the shadows are correctly removed. In contrast, ShadowReward provides a more perceptually reliable assessment by focusing on visual coherence rather than pixel-wise similarity. It assigns higher scores to restorations with natural tone and structure, and penalizes outputs with residual shadows or color inconsistency, regardless of ground-truth bias. These results highlight that PSNR fails to reflect human perceptual preference under misaligned conditions, whereas ShadowReward consistently produces scores aligned with human judgment, serving as a more reliable perceptual evaluator for shadow removal.
paragraphs.zh: 传统指标（如 PSNR）依赖于与配对真实图像在像素级上的严格对应关系，因此当两张图像出现错位时，这些指标会失去可靠性。 如图 9 所示，由临时物体（例如顶行的鞋子）或环境变化（例如底行移动的草）引起的不匹配，会导致高质量的修复结果获得不合理地低的 PSNR 分数，即便阴影已被正确去除。 相比之下，ShadowReward 更关注视觉连贯性而非像素级相似性，从而提供了更具感知可靠性的评估方式。 该指标会给予具有自然色调和结构的修复结果更高分数，并对存在残留阴影或颜色不一致的输出进行惩罚，无论真实图像是否存在偏差。 这些结果表明，在图像错位的情况下，PSNR 无法反映人类的感知偏好，而 ShadowReward 始终能生成与人类判断一致的分值，因此是更可靠的阴影去除感知评估方法。

paragraphs.en: To justify the use of ShadowReward over other possible guidance signals, we compare it against three alternative methods under the same unpaired fine-tuning protocol used for ODDR: (1) a SAM-based shadow detection model [ 4 ] , which penalizes the shadow detection confidence in the restored output to encourage shadow-free results; (2) a conditional GAN discriminator [ 20 ] , trained to distinguish unpaired shadow-free images from the restored images; and (3) a DINO-based discriminator adapted for one-step diffusion in low-level vision tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明使用 ShadowReward 相较于其他可能的引导信号更具优势，我们在与 ODDR 相同的无配对微调协议下，将其与三种替代方法进行了比较：（1）一种基于 SAM 的影子检测模型 [4]，该模型通过惩罚恢复后输出中的影子检测置信度来鼓励生成无影子的结果；（2）一种条件 GAN 判别器 [20]，经过训练以区分无配对的无影子图像与恢复后的图像；以及（3）一种基于 DINO 的判别器，已针对低层次视觉任务中的一步扩散进行了适配。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Tab. 11 , ShadowReward consistently outperforms all alternatives. The shadow detection approach only marginally improves over ODD, as it provides a binary shadow presence signal rather than fine-grained perceptual feedback. The conditional GAN discriminator suffers from unstable adversarial training dynamics in the unpaired setting and occasionally introduces new artifacts. The DINO-based discriminator performs reasonably well due to its strong structural and perceptual cue-capturing capabilities, yet it still falls short of ShadowReward by 0.58 dB in shadow-region PSNR. These results demonstrate that learning a preference ranking over restored results, as done by ShadowReward, provides a more effective supervision signal than discriminative or detection-based alternatives.

paragraphs.en: Beyond shadow-region quality, we also observe that ODD occasionally introduces undesirable color shifts in non-shadow regions, whereas ODDR effectively preserves the original color tone. This improvement can be attributed to the design of ShadowReward, which evaluates the overall perceptual quality of the restored image by comparing it against the shadow input. Since ShadowReward is trained to penalize perceptually unnatural artifacts, including chromatic distortions and luminance inconsistencies, it provides a gradient signal that discourages global color drift during ODDR fine-tuning. Combined with the alignment loss ( ℒ per \mathcal{L}_{\text{per}} and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} ) that anchors ODDR outputs to the ODD pseudo-target, the reward term selectively improves shadow regions while suppressing unintended modifications in non-shadow areas. This complementary supervision explains why ODDR achieves better color consistency across the entire image.
paragraphs.zh: 除了阴影区域的画质之外，我们还观察到 ODD 偶尔会在非阴影区域引入不理想的色彩偏移，而 ODDR 则能有效保留原始色调。 这种改进可以归因于 ShadowReward 的设计，它通过将恢复后的图像与阴影输入进行比较，来评估其整体感知质量。 由于 ShadowReward 的训练目标是惩罚那些在感知上显得不自然的伪影（包括色彩失真和亮度不一致），因此它能提供一个梯度信号，从而在 ODDR 微调过程中抑制全局性的色彩漂移。 结合对齐损失（ℒ per \mathcal{L}_{\text{per}} 和 ℓ 2 \ell_{2}），该损失将 ODDR 的输出锚定到 ODD 伪目标上，奖励项能够选择性地优化阴影区域，同时抑制非阴影区域的无意修改。 这种互补的监督机制解释了为何 ODDR 能够在整张图像中实现更好的色彩一致性。

paragraphs.en: As described in Sec. 3.2 , we introduce lightweight two-layer convolutional skip connections (ODD-Conv) at each encoder-decoder level of the VAE to mitigate the detail loss commonly observed in the original Stable Diffusion VAE. Specifically, as shown in Fig. 11 , we extract intermediate encoder features and pass them through a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to match the channel dimensions of the corresponding decoder features. The transformed encoder features are then concatenated with the decoder features, followed by a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution to fuse the information effectively. This design preserves fine-grained textures and structural details that would otherwise be lost during the VAE encoding-decoding process.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 3.2 节所述，我们在 VAE 的每个编码器-解码器层级引入了轻量级的双层卷积跳跃连接（ODD-Conv），以缓解原始 Stable Diffusion VAE 中常见的细节丢失问题。 具体而言，如图 11 所示，我们提取编码器的中间特征，并通过一个 1 × 1 1\times 1 的卷积层，使其通道维度与对应的解码器特征相匹配。 随后，将转换后的编码器特征与解码器特征进行拼接，再经过一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 的卷积层，以有效融合信息。 这种设计能够保留精细的纹理和结构细节，而这些细节在 VAE 的编码-解码过程中原本会丢失。

paragraphs.en: While ODDR achieves strong shadow removal performance without real-world paired supervision, several limitations remain. First, on extremely hard shadow boundaries with large intensity gaps, ODDR can leave faint halos or over-smooth the transition, since ShadowReward’s boundary degradation (B) is trained with only mild dilation and Gaussian blur and thus does not fully cover such out-of-distribution edges. Second, on highly textured or non-flat surfaces (e.g., grass, foliage, or fabric), the recovered shadow region may exhibit inconsistent texture or subtle color drift, as synthetic degradations do not faithfully reproduce these surface-specific interactions (Fig. 12 ). Third, ShadowReward is trained on five synthetic degradation types (texture distortion, additive noise, chromatic shift, luminance change, and boundary artifact), and therefore provides limited supervision against artifacts that lie outside this taxonomy, such as semantic inconsistency or geometric misalignment introduced by the diffusion prior. Finally, our framework is developed under the standard single-image setting with a static scene and a single dominant light source; extensions to video shadow removal, multi-light or soft cast shadows, and joint reasoning with scene geometry are promising directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ODDR 在没有真实世界配对监督的情况下实现了出色的阴影去除效果，但仍存在若干局限性。 首先，在具有较大强度差异的极端复杂阴影边界上，ODDDR 可能会留下微弱的晕圈或过度平滑过渡区域，因为 ShadowReward 的边界退化（B）仅通过轻微膨胀和高斯模糊进行训练，因此无法完全覆盖此类分布外的边缘。 其次，在纹理密集或非平面的表面（例如草地、植被或织物）上，恢复出的阴影区域可能会出现纹理不一致或细微的颜色偏移，因为合成退化方式未能真实再现这些与表面相关的特定交互（图 12）。 第三，ShadowReward 是在五种合成退化类型（纹理失真、加法噪声、色偏、亮度变化和边界伪影）上进行训练的，因此对于超出这一分类的伪影（例如扩散先验引入的语义不一致或几何错位），其提供的监督作用有限。 最后，我们的框架是在标准单图像设置下开发的，场景为静态且仅有一个主要光源；将其扩展到视频阴影去除、多光源或柔和投射阴影，以及与场景几何结构进行联合推理，都是未来研究的潜在方向。

sents.en: While ODDR achieves strong shadow removal performance without real-world paired supervision, several limitations remain.
sents.zh: 尽管 ODDR 在没有真实世界配对监督的情况下实现了出色的阴影去除效果，但仍存在若干局限性。

sents.en: First, on extremely hard shadow boundaries with large intensity gaps, ODDR can leave faint halos or over-smooth the transition, since ShadowReward’s boundary degradation (B) is trained with only mild dilation and Gaussian blur and thus does not fully cover such out-of-distribution edges.
sents.zh: 首先，在具有较大强度差异的极端复杂阴影边界上，ODDDR 可能会留下微弱的晕圈或过度平滑过渡区域，因为 ShadowReward 的边界退化（B）仅通过轻微膨胀和高斯模糊进行训练，因此无法完全覆盖此类分布外的边缘。

sents.en: Second, on highly textured or non-flat surfaces (e.g., grass, foliage, or fabric), the recovered shadow region may exhibit inconsistent texture or subtle color drift, as synthetic degradations do not faithfully reproduce these surface-specific interactions (Fig. 12 ).
sents.zh: 其次，在纹理密集或非平面的表面（例如草地、植被或织物）上，恢复出的阴影区域可能会出现纹理不一致或细微的颜色偏移，因为合成退化方式未能真实再现这些与表面相关的特定交互（图 12）。

sents.en: Third, ShadowReward is trained on five synthetic degradation types (texture distortion, additive noise, chromatic shift, luminance change, and boundary artifact), and therefore provides limited supervision against artifacts that lie outside this taxonomy, such as semantic inconsistency or geometric misalignment introduced by the diffusion prior.
sents.zh: 第三，ShadowReward 是在五种合成退化类型（纹理失真、加法噪声、色偏、亮度变化和边界伪影）上进行训练的，因此对于超出这一分类的伪影（例如扩散先验引入的语义不一致或几何错位），其提供的监督作用有限。

sents.en: Finally, our framework is developed under the standard single-image setting with a static scene and a single dominant light source; extensions to video shadow removal, multi-light or soft cast shadows, and joint reasoning with scene geometry are promising directions for future work.
sents.zh: 最后，我们的框架是在标准单图像设置下开发的，场景为静态且仅有一个主要光源；将其扩展到视频阴影去除、多光源或柔和投射阴影，以及与场景几何结构进行联合推理，都是未来研究的潜在方向。

paragraphs.en: ODDR is a low-level restoration method with limited misuse risk; like any image-editing tool, restored outputs should be treated as edited rather than original.
paragraphs.zh: ODDR 是一种低级别的恢复方法，误用风险有限；与任何图像编辑工具一样，恢复后的输出应被视为经过编辑的结果，而非原始内容。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide additional visual results to further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our proposed method across diverse scenes and conditions. As shown in Fig. 13 , our method achieves significantly better visual quality on the AISTD [ 27 ] dataset than existing unsupervised shadow removal approaches, producing cleaner shadow-free regions and more consistent illumination. Moreover, even when compared with supervised methods, our results exhibit only marginal differences, highlighting the strong generalization capability of our framework despite the absence of paired supervision. Fig. 14 presents qualitative results on unseen datasets [ 9 , 14 ] , demonstrating the strong generalization ability of our ODDR framework. Despite never being trained on these datasets, ODDR consistently removes shadows while preserving natural color and structure, whereas existing methods often leave residual shadows or introduce color distortions. These results further confirm that ODDR is highly robust to domain shifts and remains effective even in challenging unseen scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们提供了额外的可视化结果，以进一步展示所提方法在不同场景和条件下的有效性与鲁棒性。 如图 13 所示，在 AISTD [ 27 ] 数据集上，我们的方法比现有的无监督阴影移除方法实现了显著更高的视觉质量，生成了更纯净的无阴影区域和更一致的光照效果。 此外，即使与有监督方法相比，我们的结果也仅存在微小差异，这凸显了尽管没有成对监督数据，我们的框架仍具备强大的泛化能力。 图 14 展示了在未见过数据集 [ 9 , 14 ] 上的定性结果，证明了 ODDR 框架的强大泛化能力。 尽管从未在这些数据集上进行过训练，ODDR 仍能一致地移除阴影，同时保留自然的色彩和结构；而现有方法通常会残留阴影或引入色彩失真。 这些结果进一步证实了 ODDR 对域偏移具有高度鲁棒性，即使在具有挑战性的未知场景中也能保持有效。

paragraphs.en: To provide a more comprehensive analysis of our framework, we present additional visual comparisons between ODD and ODDR across multiple datasets. Fig. 15 shows qualitative results on the AISTD dataset, where ODDR produces cleaner shadow removal and more stable color consistency than ODD. Furthermore, as illustrated in Fig. 16 and Fig. 17 , ODDR demonstrates superior performance on unseen datasets such as LRSS and UIUC, effectively preserving structural details while removing shadows that ODD occasionally fails to eliminate. paragraphs.zh: 为了更全面地分析我们的框架，我们提供了 ODD 与 ODDR 在多个数据集上的额外视觉对比。 图 15 展示了 AISTD 数据集上的定性结果，其中 ODDR 的阴影去除效果更干净，颜色一致性也比 ODD 更稳定。 此外，如图 16 和图 17 所示，ODDR 在 LRSS 和 UIUC 等未见过的数据集上表现出更优异的性能，能够在有效保留结构细节的同时去除 ODD 偶尔无法消除的阴影。 这些结果共同凸显了奖励引导优化的优势，并证实了 ODDR 在已见和未见的领域中都实现了更稳健、更具感知一致性的恢复效果。
